question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Hatred
solution:
The correct answer is Malevolence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'hatred' means 'intense dislike; hate'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Malleable- Able to be hammered or pressed into shape without breaking or cracking.
 
• Malevolence- The state or condition of being malevolent; hostility. 
 
• Magnanimous- Generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person.
 
• Malapropos- In an inopportune or inappropriate way.
 
 
 
• Hence the most appropriate one word substitute for the group of words 'hatred' is 'malevolence'.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.
